en.v: after he was told his daughter stole a mobile phone from her deskmate.

examples.zh: 父亲得知女儿偷了她同桌的手机后，大发脾气。

errata.note: 词组标准形式为 lose one’s temper，原书漏印 one’s；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 135 条）确认更正

errata.original: Father lost temper after he was told his daughter stole a mobile phone from her deskmate.
errata.corrected: Father lost his temper after he was told his daughter stole a mobile phone from her deskmate.
errata.note: 例句漏印 his（书末答案为 lost his temper）；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 135 条）确认更正
